plugins.name: sllmwiki
plugins.description: Structural LLM Wiki (sllmwiki) is an agent skill, packaged as a Claude Code plugin, that turns a git repository into a wiki your coding agent researches and keeps current. Start with /sllmwiki:init in an empty repository. Guide: https://github.com/mengjiasun1992/structural-llm-wiki/blob/mainline/README.md
